1790882060.000149.text: Model mixes Spanish and English even though the user asked for Spanish.

1790937414.000152.text:
[QA clarification]
Issue: Is normal loanword use different from unwanted code-switching?
Question: what is the correct handling for this task?
A loanword is different from an unrequested language change across a whole sentence.

1790876285.000158.text: Could QA clarify this case: Keigo suddenly becomes casual — how to score?
Is there a discourse reason to switch speech level? A purposeful switch between speakers differs from accidental keigo inconsistency.
Japanese QA needs the beginning and ending forms to determine whether the shift is stylistic or erroneous. A purposeful switch between speakers differs from accidental keigo inconsistency.
